raw_response: The figure presents a line chart illustrating the percentage of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) for various entities over time. The horizontal axis represents years, ranging from 1995 to 2023, with tick marks at each year. The vertical axis is labeled "% des BIP" and spans from -1.0 to 3.5, with tick marks at intervals of 0.5. Three data series are displayed: "Bund" (federal), "Länder" (states), and "Gemeinden" (municipalities), each represented by a differently colored line. "Bund" is depicted in blue, "Länder" in green, and "Gemeinden" in a lighter shade of green. A fourth data series, "Gebietskörperschaften insgesamt" (total public bodies), is shown as a black line. The lines fluctuate over the time period, with no apparent consistent upward or downward trend across all series. The chart includes annotations labeled "Bahnreform" (rail reform) indicated by vertical dashed lines at approximately the years 1996 and 2002, and 2013. The lines are not sorted in any particular order, and no specific bars or lines are visually emphasized beyond their distinct colors.
